jobs.title: IT Strategy and Transformation Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Role:

The IT Strategy and Transformation function is a small, senior team responsible for shaping firm-wide technology strategy at Baird. This role offers the opportunity to influence critical, firm-wide initiatives with regular exposure to our Chief Information Officer and Senior IT Leadership Team. Our business-pull approach starts with the priorities of Baird's business units and CRGs and stewards smart, long-term technology decisions.

This is a business and strategy-oriented role rather than a technical one, so deep technical experience is not required. You will work across the IT department and with stakeholders outside of IT, gaining broad perspective while helping advance technology as a core part of Baird's business strategy, growth and transformation

We are looking for someone who has already sharpened their strategic and analytical toolkit, ideally through strategy consulting or a similarly rigorous background, and is ready to contribute to a firm-wide agenda from day one. You will drive strategic priorities across the organization, applying proven strategic thinking and business acumen rather than learning these fundamentals on the job. Just as important is the judgment to know when to move forward independently and when to seek input.. You will have significant flexibility in the tools, processes and approaches you use within a collaborative culture that values diverse backgrounds, teamwork, partnership, client results and community involvement.
This position offers a hybrid working arrangement based in Milwaukee, with at least 3 to 4 days per week in the office and the remaining time remote. This schedule supports relationship building and consensus across leaders and teams.

The Impact You’ll Make:
- Conduct independent analysis, research and critical thinking to support IT Strategy & Transformation at Baird on critical, firm-wide projects that touch a variety of teams and leaders, offering the opportunity to influence and drive significant business outcomes
- Work directly with our CIO and Senior IT Leadership Team on strategic priorities, bringing polished executive communication skills and the judgment to navigate competing viewpoints, ambiguity and organizational complexity
- Lead communications and change management efforts to increase visibility and drive adoption of important Baird technology initiatives, building alignment across IT, business unit and CRG teams while interfacing with stakeholders throughout and beyond the IT department
- Partner with senior IT leaders to drive strategic projects in their IT areas, including current state/future state/gap analysis, people/process/technology assessments, strategic roadmaps, resource planning and executive scorecards/reporting
- Lead focus groups, conduct stakeholder interviews and synthesize key takeaways into clear findings
- Lead quantitative data analysis and Excel modeling, building structured models with clear assumptions and outputs and developing the instinct to identify when numbers do not look right
- Develop the storyline and narrative for executive presentations before building slides, distilling complex analysis into clear key messages and recommendations tailored to senior audiences
- Support and drive strategic analyses around potential technology initiatives, helping advance technology as a core part of Baird's business strategy, growth and transformation
- Support and drive content creation for bi-monthly IT Committee meetings with senior Baird leaders
- Participate in periodic review of emerging/disruptive technology trends and applicability to Baird's businesses

What You’ll Bring to Baird:
- A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience, with approximately 3 to 7 years preferred
- Strong preference for a background in strategy consulting or corporate strategy, which provides the rigorous strategic and analytical foundation needed to succeed in this role; a post-MBA candidate with relevant pre-MBA experience is also a strong fit
- Demonstrated ability to operate independently on ambiguous problems, structuring them into clear next steps without significant oversight, paired with the judgment to know when to escalate or ask for input rather than push ahead alone
- Composure operating in a high-stakes, fast-moving environment, including comfort with tight turnarounds, occasional work outside standard hours and having polished work substantially reworked or scrapped as senior leadership direction evolves
- Strong quantitative intuition, including experience building clean Excel models and pressure-testing data to identify inconsistencies
- Proven experience developing storylines and executive-ready presentations, including translating analysis into clear implications and recommendations for senior leaders
- Executive presence and advanced written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated comfort presenting to and navigating discussions with senior leadership
- Experience driving change management efforts and conducting stakeholder interviews or focus groups
- Strong organizational navigation skills, with the ability to build relationships, engage stakeholders early and understand informal decision dynamics
- Sound judgment and professional presence, with the discipline to focus on the highest-impact work and adapt as priorities shift
- Excellent collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to influence without authority and value diverse perspectives and shared success
- Exceptional Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel skills; Power BI knowledge a plus, with strong technology aptitude and the ability to adopt new tools, including AI-enabled solutions, preferred
- A Bachelor's degree in an analytical discipline such as business, economics, statistics or mathematics, or a technology discipline such as computer science or MIS; MBA helpful but not required, or equivalent experience

Compensation and Benefits:
- Compensation and bonus are commensurate with experience, performance and/or firm profitability
- You’ll have the opportunity to advance your career while enjoying our comprehensive benefits designed for your life, career and future.

Baird is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Analyst - Tech & Services
jobs.description:
About the Role:
At Baird, our Investment Bankers are dedicated to excellence and quality, fostering a team-oriented environment that leads to outstanding results and employee fulfillment. We are seeking an Investment Banking Analyst in the Tech & Services sector to support growth. This role requires a motivated individual with sell-side experience. Our Global Investment Banking division provides M&A, debt advisory, and financing services to middle-market companies. As a Baird Investment Banker, you'll work on high-profile transactions, gaining insights across various sectors while contributing to our clients' long-term success.

The Impact You’ll Make:
- Demonstrate strong commercial judgment and market awareness, with a deep understanding of the investment banking landscape, key industry trends, and client priorities

- Analyze complex financial statements and business performance metrics to identify opportunities, risks, and key value drivers

- Handle, review, and synthesise large volumes of data, identifying and clearly articulating the patterns, trends, inconsistencies, and opportunities that inform the team’s analysis and recommendations

- Build and maintain sophisticated financial models, including valuation, merger consequences, LBO, and operating models to support strategic advice and transaction execution

- Review a range of business models and key performance metrics to help build a compelling investment case and equity story, and prepare clear, concise, and compelling written materials, including client communications, transaction documentation

- Support the execution of live transactions across M&A, capital raising, and strategic advisory engagements working directly with senior bankers, C-suite and management teams, and third-party advisers

- Develop high-quality client presentations and marketing materials that communicate complex financial and strategic concepts with clarity and impact

- Maintain a strong understanding of global capital markets, equity performance, and broader economic trends to inform client discussions and transaction strategy

- Work on cross-border and multi-market transactions, drawing on Baird’s international platform and global reach to advise clients well beyond a single regional market

- Conduct in-depth company, industry, and market research using leading investment banking databases and proprietary resources to generate insights and support client recommendations

What You’ll Bring to Baird:
- A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent), ideally in a numerate, business, or related discipline

- 1-2 years of experience in Investment Banking (sell-side M&A, corporate finance, or transaction services)

- A genuine interest in, and working knowledge of, the Technology & Services sector; prior sector-coverage experience is a plus

- A strong academic record and interest in finance and capital markets

- A solid work ethic, teamwork skills, and self-direction

- Excellent quantitative, writing, and verbal communication

- Strong data-analysis skills, with the ability to handle, review, and synthesise large volumes of information to identify patterns, trends, and outliers

- Strong organisational skills, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; familiarity with financial databases (e.g. Capital IQ, PitchBook, Mergermarket) is an advantage

- Fluency in English; additional European languages an advantage

- A genuine drive to win and a strong commitment to internal and external client service

- The ability to adapt quickly to new tasks and thrive under changing priorities

- Ability to assess financing alternatives and capital structure considerations
- Commercial judgement and awareness of market dynamics affecting financing and M&A activity
- Interest in capital markets, economic trends and private capital solutions

- Strong teamwork and collaboration skills
- Ability to build trusted relationships with clients and colleagues
- A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset

jobs.title: Internship – Continuous Improvement Analyst (Year-Round)
jobs.description:
About the Role:
The Business Process team is part of Baird’s Operations Department (“Ops”), which is the best kept secret in the financial services industry and plays a critical role to the success and growth of the firm. The Business Process team helps identify opportunities for improvement and drives efficiencies to solve problems.

Continuous improvement provides high value service and subject matter expertise on regulations and policies with a thorough understanding of end-to-end processes to internal and external clients. Continuous Improvement Analysts research, resolve and respond to daily end user questions, and they identify problem areas backed by documented metrics and analysis and collaborate on appropriate solutions. The Continuous Improvement Analyst intern will gain hands-on experience working with the team, across Operations and with clients. We look for highly motivated individuals who are curious, analytical and interested in understanding how people, processes and technology work together to create business value.

This is a hybrid internship, working four days per week in our downtown Milwaukee, WI office and one day remote. The intern must be able to work full time during the summer, 37.5-40 hours per week, and work part time during the school semesters, 15-20 hours per week. We are seeking a local student who can start in June 2027.

The Impact You’ll Make:
- Provide strong client service and technical support to the team, clients and associates
- Support research and resolution of end-user questions
- Assist with manual testing of workflow solutions, documentation of issues and solutions and metric tracking
- Help with system administration activities such as user, role and permission setup and error-log monitoring
- Analyze existing automated processes and identify improvement opportunities using documented metrics
- Collaborate with the team to update user guides, training materials, process models and decision models
- Contribute to process improvement work by sharing observations and recommendations to improve client and associate experiences
- Gain exposure to Operations, Business Process, Continuous Improvement, Private Wealth Management and the financial services industry through team meetings, trainings and collaboration with associates across these teams

What You’ll Bring to Baird:
- Pursuing a bachelor’s degree in business administration, management information systems, information technology, operations management, finance with a technology concentration, communications or related degree
- Anticipated graduation date of May 2028 or later
- Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to connect clearly and professionally with clients and associates and communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical personnel
- Commitment to delivering excellent customer service to clients and associates
- Organizational excellence, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities, demonstrate strong attention to detail and ensure high-quality and on-time delivery

- High level of motivation, proactivity and strategic thinking, with a strong commitment to learning and contributing effectively

- Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate information and identify actionable solutions
- Desire to learn new systems and policies

- Experience with Jira, Azure or other tracking tools is preferred
- Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office products, including strong Word, Excel, PowerPoint and SharePoint

About Our Intern Program:
Jumpstart your career with Baird’s high-impact summer intern program! You’ll gain real-world experience, connect with inspiring leaders and grow through hands-on projects, mentorship and dynamic events. From our Intern Welcome and Baird Gives Back Day to firmwide networking and professional development, you’ll be part of a vibrant, collaborative culture that values your voice and fuels your future.

You will collaborate across Finance, Corporate Resource groups and Baird’s businesses to provide accounting and regulatory guidance for new initiatives, products and significant transactions.

This opportunity offers meaningful exposure to leaders and teams across the firm, a track record of career progression and the ability to expand your expertise in an evolving, fast-paced environment. We are seeking an Investment Banking Associate to join our Technology & Services team and support its continued growth. The successful candidate will bring strong sell-side transaction experience, sound commercial judgement and the ability to take ownership of key execution workstreams. Baird’s Global Investment Banking division provides M&A, debt advisory and equity financing services to middle-market companies, entrepreneurs and financial sponsors. As an Associate, you will play a central role in executing transactions, developing junior team members and supporting senior bankers in delivering high-quality strategic advice to clients.

The Impact You’ll Make:
- Take ownership of key workstreams across live M&A, capital raising and strategic advisory engagements, helping to drive transactions from preparation through execution and completion
- Apply strong commercial judgement and market awareness to assess businesses, identify key value drivers and risks, and contribute to clear, well-supported client recommendations
- Lead the analysis of complex financial statements, operating data and business performance metrics, ensuring conclusions are accurate, commercially relevant and clearly communicated
- Build, review and refine sophisticated financial models, including valuation, merger consequences, LBO and operating models, and oversee the quality of supporting analysis
- Develop compelling investment cases and equity stories by assessing business models, market positioning, growth opportunities and key performance indicators
- Prepare and review high-quality client presentations, marketing materials, transaction documentation and other written communications that convey complex financial and strategic concepts with clarity and impact
- Coordinate effectively with senior bankers, management teams, clients and third-party advisers to maintain momentum, manage deliverables and support a well-run transaction process
- Guide and review the work of Analysts, providing clear direction, constructive feedback and day-to-day coaching while helping to maintain consistently high standards across the team
- Support client and business development activity through sector research, company analysis, idea generation and the preparation of pitches and strategic materials
- Maintain a strong understanding of the Technology & Services landscape, global capital markets and broader economic trends, and apply those insights to client discussions and transaction strategy

What You’ll Bring to Baird:
- A bachelor’s degree (or equivalent), ideally in a numerate, business or related discipline
- Typically 3-5 years of relevant experience in investment banking, with meaningful exposure to sell-side M&A execution; comparable corporate finance or transaction advisory experience may also be considered
- The ability to utilise AI as a productivity and analytical tool, while exercising sound judgement on where human insight, critical thinking, and client judgement remain essential
- A genuine interest in, and strong working knowledge of, the Technology & Services sector; prior sector coverage experience is preferred
- Demonstrated experience managing significant transaction workstreams and producing high-quality analysis and materials under demanding timelines
- Strong financial modelling, valuation and accounting skills, with the confidence to review and challenge analysis produced by others
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex information clearly and engage credibly with senior internal and external stakeholders
- Strong leadership and teamwork skills, with the ability to delegate effectively, support junior colleagues and contribute positively to a collaborative team environment
- Exceptional organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word; familiarity with financial databases such as Capital IQ, PitchBook and Mergermarket is an advantage
- Fluency in English; additional European languages are an advantage
- A genuine drive to win and a strong commitment to delivering outstanding internal and external client service
- The judgement, resilience and adaptability to operate effectively as priorities change and transactions evolve

jobs.description:
About the Role
Baird Capital is seeking an Associate to join the Global Fund investment team within our private equity business. Baird Capital is the direct private investment group of Robert W. Baird & Co. (“Baird”) and invests in growing B2B technology and services businesses. Baird is a leading, employee-owned middle-market financial services firm with more than 5,200 employees and over 200 locations across the U.S. and Europe. Baird has been named to Fortune Magazine's 100 Best Companies to Work For list for 23 consecutive years. Our affiliation with Baird provides access to a global knowledge platform and extensive intellectual and human capital across the sectors in which we invest.

Our private equity team has a 35+ year track record of partnering with founder-led businesses to build market-leading platforms. Supported by a global team across North America, Europe, and Asia and a flexible, stage-agnostic capital base, we tailor our investment approach to the unique needs of each business.
Baird Capital is investing out of its 3rd flagship Global Fund ($450M) targeting majority and minority investments in founder or entrepreneur led businesses across technology services & software, industrial sustainability, and pharmaceutical commercialization.

The Associate will support the full investment lifecycle, including evaluating new opportunities, conducting due diligence, executing transactions, and supporting existing portfolio companies. The role provides exposure to senior investment professionals, portfolio-company leadership teams, and internal and external advisors. Responsibilities and ownership are expected to grow as the Associate demonstrates readiness to take on additional responsibility.

This position follows a hybrid schedule, with Monday through Thursday in the Chicago office and Friday remote. The anticipated start date is Summer 2027.

Learn more about our team and investment approach on the Baird Capital website.

The Impact You’ll Make
- Evaluate Opportunities: Screen investments, conduct company and industry research, and assess key value drivers and risks.
- Execute Transactions: Support due diligence, financial modeling, valuation, deal structuring, and investment committee materials.
- Portfolio Management: Monitor performance, track key metrics, and contribute to board materials, strategic initiatives, and add-on acquisitions.
- Collaborate Across Teams: Work with Baird colleagues, portfolio-company leaders, and external advisors throughout the investment lifecycle.
- Grow as an Investor: Build investment judgment and take on greater responsibility over time, with potential opportunities for a UK secondment.

What You’ll Bring to Baird
- Highly motivated with a strong work ethic, sound judgment, and consistent attention to detail.
- Able to manage multiple priorities and work effectively both independently and collaboratively.
- Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with confidence presenting to senior audiences.
- Ability to build effective relationships with colleagues, portfolio-company teams, and external advisors.
- Strong research, financial modeling, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- At least two years of experience in investment banking or private equity.
- Strong academic record from a leading institution.

Compensation and Benefits
- Base salary range of $120,000 to $130,000.
- Significant bonus and profit-sharing opportunity.
- Compensation and bonus are commensurate with experience, individual performance, and firm profitability.
- Additional information is available in the Total Rewards at Baird summary.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Analyst – Debt Advisory
jobs.description:
High-profile deals, major growth, the right people behind you. Grow far at Baird. ​
Baird offers a different kind of start to a career in investment banking, built on high-performing teams and a culture that supports your growth. ​ Here, you’ll build skills through real transactions, close collaboration with peers and mentors, and a culture focused on shared success.​

About Debt Advisory (DA):
We deliver a broad range of highly customized debt solutions across the capital structure, ranging from debt financing to capital structure advisory services for institutional clients in the United States and Europe. Our debt advisory services include growth financings, acquisition financings, dividend recapitalizations, refinancings, stressed financings, debt exchanges, out-of-court restructurings as well as Chapter 11 transactions. Our deep sector expertise enables us to optimally position companies within a sector, advise clients through complex situations and deliver solutions that support our clients’ long-term strategic objectives. We possess strong relationships with an extensive and diverse list of lenders and investors, including banks, private credit funds, private equity funds, hedge funds, family offices and alternative capital providers, creating competitive processes that optimize outcomes.

What You’ll Do​
Learn by doing and be trusted with meaningful work from the jump​

- Play an integral role on investment banking teams, providing analytical support on financing and restructuring transactions
- Assist in preparing various financial analyses to evaluate transaction alternatives, developing marketing documents and financial models and administering marketing and due diligence processes
- Assist senior bankers in business development efforts with prospective corporate and PE clients
- Develop your skills through broad exposure to clients, investors and Baird bankers
- Use AI tools like Rogo and auxi to streamline the creation of pitch books and models, and employ data visualization software like Power BI to generate data-driven insights and reports for client materials

What You’ll Gain​
The kind of environment that turns early talent into lasting careers​

- Exposure to a wide breadth of debt-oriented transactions, ranging from growth financings to restructurings
- Direct exposure to senior members of the Debt Advisory team
- Achieve professional development through lean deal teams which provide greater responsibility and daily interaction with senior bankers / investment professionals
- Unique culture that values diverse backgrounds and perspectives while emphasizing teamwork and a strong sense of partnership
- You will gain an expert understanding of the drivers of credit quality, mechanics of credit agreements and credit market dynamics, including its participants
- You will develop as a debt expert across Baird’s breadth of industry verticals with leading companies across their respective sub-verticals

What It Takes​
We’re looking for people who want to go far, and go together​

- Strong work ethic, intellectual curiosity, demonstrated leadership ability, attention to detail, ability to work in teams and a commitment to excellence
- Credit experience including the proven ability to assist in execution of all aspects of leveraged financings across multiple transaction types (LBOs, recapitalizations, refinancings, add-on acquisitions and special situations)
- Candidates must also display a professional demeanor and an ability to learn in a fast-paced, challenging environment
- Prior leveraged finance, debt advisory, direct lending, restructuring or M&A experience preferred
- 1-3 years of prior experience
- Experience with AI tools such as Rogo, CoPilot, and auxi is preferred
- Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar

Compensation and Benefits:
- $110,000 - $125,000 annual salary with bonus potential

- Compensation and bonus are commensurate with experience, performance and/or GIB profitability

- In addition to a strong culture that is focused on health and well-being, our organization offers competitive total compensation packages and  comprehensive benefits  including: protected Friday night and Saturdays, periodic sabbaticals during career, shareholder opportunities, mandatory paid time off (PTO) and robust 401k match and profit-sharing contribution
